sections.title: A jegy is a ticket
sections.content: A *jegy* is a ticket, for a bus, a tram or a train. You ask for it the way you ask for food: it is the thing you want, so it takes *-t*, with a linking vowel after the consonant: *jegy → jegyet*. After a number the noun stays singular, as you know from *két kávé*, and the thing you ask for still gets *-t*: *két jegyet*. To ask the price, use *Mennyibe kerül?*

items.english: How many tickets do you need?

sections.content: After a number the noun stays singular: *két jegyet*, not *két jegyeket*. The *-t* goes on the noun because it is what you ask for, not because there are more than one.
